    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith('- '):
        continue
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line[2:]
    # Split on " RELEASED_AT "
    parts = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        continue
    song_part = parts[0]
    release_part = parts[1]
    # song_part is "Title BY Artist1, Artist2"
    # Split on " BY "
    if ' BY ' in song_part:
        title, artists_str = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
    else:
        title = song_part
        artists_str = ''
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',') if a.strip()]
    songs.append({
        'title': title.strip(),
        'artists': artists,
        'release': release_part.strip()
    })

print(f"Total songs: {len(songs)}")
